instruction: What is Northstar Health's current production-readiness review date?
rationale: Repeated Timeline headings plus a superseded appendix date.

instruction: In Harbor Retail's Risks section, add that the corrected identifier crosswalk is owned by Diego Ruiz.
expected_edit_scope: Add only the ownership sentence to Harbor Retail > Risks.
rationale: The same child heading appears under two clients.

instruction: When is the current client timeline milestone?
rationale: Pass: asks which client. Fail: selects Northstar or Harbor without clarification. Ambiguous: presents both current client milestones and explains that the client was not specified.

instruction: What is Harbor Retail's current catalog-synchronization stabilization date?
rationale: The current Harbor date is in Harbor Retail > Timeline; the superseded August 2 date in the appendix is a distractor.

instruction: What is the Web Application deployment window for Atlas 4.8?
must_not_target: ["Mobile Applications > Deployment Window", "Platform Services > Deployment Window"]
rationale: A control with explicit parent context.

instruction: Update the rollback instructions for the client that cannot recall already-installed binaries to say the phased release must be paused immediately.
expected_edit_scope: Modify only Mobile Applications > Rollback Plan to require immediate pause.
must_not_target: ["Web Application > Rollback Plan", "Platform Services > Rollback Plan"]
rationale: The target is identified by a semantic property, not its heading.

instruction: Which deployment happens immediately before the web production deployment?
expected_answer: Platform service rollout on September 23, 2026 at 18:00 UTC
rationale: Requires comparing current release dates while ignoring history.

instruction: When is the Platform Services rollout scheduled?
must_not_target: ["Web Application > Deployment Window", "Mobile Applications > Deployment Window"]
rationale: The named parent identifies one of three repeated Deployment Window sections.

instruction: In the Web Application Validation section, add that saved-search regression must be signed off by Priya Nair before the go/no-go call.
expected_edit_scope: Add only the sign-off requirement to Web Application > Validation.
rationale: Validation repeats under three parents; the instruction explicitly names Web Application.

instruction: Which vendor is recommended to advance as preferred?
rationale: Requires resolving the committee recommendation.

instruction: In the assessment for the lower-cost vendor with the mandatory control exception, clarify that customer-managed encryption keys are unavailable today.
expected_edit_scope: Clarify current unavailability only in Beacon Desk > Security Assessment.
must_not_target: ["Beacon Desk > Commercial Assessment", "Appendix A > Vendor Claims Matrix"]
rationale: Cost clue appears outside the intended target; appendix contains similar wording.

instruction: Does the committee conclude that Cedar Support has complete privileged-access review evidence?
expected_answer: No; the evidence was incomplete at the deadline.
rationale: Distinguishes committee finding from vendor claims appendix.

instruction: What is Aster Cloud's three-year evaluated cost?
must_not_target: ["Beacon Desk > Commercial Assessment", "Cedar Support > Commercial Assessment"]
rationale: Commercial Assessment repeats for each vendor; the vendor name supplies the parent context.

instruction: What overall numerical score did Beacon Desk receive?
must_not_target: ["Beacon Desk > Security Assessment", "Beacon Desk > Commercial Assessment", "Beacon Desk > Recommendation"]
rationale: The report states scoring rules but never gives Beacon Desk an overall numerical score.

instruction: What was the root cause of the March 31 incident?
expected_answer: A rollout reduced consumer concurrency while campaign volume doubled.
rationale: Straightforward current-incident control.

instruction: Add replay-test ownership to the section immediately after Long-Term Actions: Jordan Lee from SRE.
expected_edit_scope: Add Jordan Lee as replay-test owner only in Verification.
rationale: Target is defined by stable sibling order.

instruction: How long were customer notifications delayed, and were any messages lost?
rationale: A related duration appears in the adjacent severity section.

instruction: At what time did the incident commander increase consumer capacity, and what else happened at the same time?
expected_answer: 14:27 UTC; nonessential campaign traffic was disabled
rationale: Both requested facts appear together in the Mitigation section.

instruction: How long must delegated-administration audit history remain searchable?
rationale: Appendix contains a plausible superseded value.

instruction: In the requirement governing invitations, suspensions, and restores, add that bulk suspension is excluded from the first release.
expected_edit_scope: Add the exclusion only to 3.2 User Lifecycle.
rationale: Instruction describes content rather than heading.

instruction: What can an administrator do in this release?
acceptable_section_paths: ["3. Functional Requirements > 3.1 Role Assignment", "3. Functional Requirements > 3.2 User Lifecycle"]
rationale: Pass: asks whether the user means a central administrator or Team Administrator. Fail: combines the two roles or assigns one role's powers to the other. Ambiguous: describes both supported interpretations with their distinct scopes.

instruction: In what format can audit history be exported?
rationale: The export format is stated directly in the authoritative Audit History requirement.

instruction: Does the first release support custom role design?
expected_answer: No; custom role design is excluded from the first release
must_not_target: ["1. Product Context > 1.2 Goals", "3. Functional Requirements > 3.1 Role Assignment"]
rationale: The authoritative exclusion appears under Non-Goals despite related role language elsewhere.

instruction: Who approves inventory adjustments after a cycle-count variance?
rationale: Exceptions repeats under three procedures.

instruction: Does the current receiving procedure require a paper tally?
expected_answer: No; the current procedure does not require a paper tally.
rationale: Deprecated appendix contains the distractor requirement.

instruction: In Receiving > Exceptions, add that exceptions pending resolution must be rescanned by inventory control before any status change is applied.
expected_edit_scope: Add only the rescan requirement to 2. Receiving > 2.2 Exceptions.
must_not_target: ["3. Cycle Counting > 3.2 Exceptions", "4. Outbound Fulfillment > 4.2 Exceptions"]
rationale: Exceptions repeats under three operational procedures; Receiving identifies the intended parent.

instruction: Which current region finished above plan, and by how much?
expected_answer: North America, at 104 percent of plan (4 percentage points above).
rationale: Requires comparison across repeated results.

instruction: In the Pipeline section for the region with 2.3 times coverage, add that Sofia Marin owns public-sector deal reviews.
expected_edit_scope: Add ownership to Europe > Pipeline only.
rationale: The numeric clue resolves Europe among repeated Pipeline headings; the nearby Europe Actions section contains the public-sector distractor but is outside the explicitly requested edit scope.

instruction: What are Europe's current-quarter bookings?
rationale: Same region and metric appear in history.

instruction: What is the current pipeline coverage ratio?
rationale: Three current regional Pipeline sections contain different coverage ratios, and the question omits the region.

instruction: What were Europe's first-quarter bookings, and which section contains that historical figure?
expected_answer: €4.6 million, 96 percent of plan; Prior Quarter > Europe Results
rationale: The question explicitly requests first-quarter history rather than the current Q2 Europe result.

instruction: What are the exit criteria for Phase 3 — Validation?
expected_answer: No open severity-one defect and all material reconciliations approved.
must_not_target: ["Phase 2 — Configuration > Exit Criteria", "Phase 4 — Launch and Stabilization > Exit Criteria"]
rationale: Control with explicit phase parent.

instruction: Where is operational acceptance required before the program can exit?
expected_section_path: Phase 4 — Launch and Stabilization > Exit Criteria
rationale: Wording differs from the heading and also appears near support handoff.

instruction: In the Phase 2 Exit Criteria, add that the security review must be countersigned by the CISO before the phase can close.
expected_edit_scope: Add only the countersignature requirement to Phase 2 — Configuration > Exit Criteria.
must_not_target: ["Phase 1 — Discovery > Exit Criteria", "Phase 3 — Validation > Exit Criteria", "Phase 4 — Launch and Stabilization > Exit Criteria"]
rationale: Exit Criteria repeats under four phases; the phase number uniquely identifies the edit target.

instruction: According to the dependency register, which phase depends on training environments?
rationale: The phrase 'According to the dependency register' makes the appendix register the sole evidence target.

instruction: How far in advance should I request a long vacation?
acceptable_section_paths: ["2. United States Employees > 2.1 Time Off", "3. United Kingdom Employees > 3.1 Time Off"]
rationale: Pass: asks for work location/worker type. Fail: gives one jurisdiction's rule as universal. Ambiguous: presents both employee rules and explains the dependency.

instruction: Change the advance notice for long annual leave to twenty calendar days.
acceptable_section_paths: ["2. United States Employees > 2.1 Time Off", "3. United Kingdom Employees > 3.1 Time Off"]
expected_edit_scope: Do not edit until jurisdiction is clarified.
rationale: Pass: asks which jurisdiction. Fail: edits either or both without clarification. Ambiguous: identifies both candidate policies but proposes no change.

instruction: Do contractors receive paid employee leave under this manual?
expected_answer: No; paid employee leave policies do not apply.
must_not_target: ["2. United States Employees > 2.1 Time Off", "3. United Kingdom Employees > 3.1 Time Off"]
rationale: Requires the contractor parent context.

instruction: For UK employees, how much advance notice is required for long leave?
must_not_target: ["2. United States Employees > 2.1 Time Off", "4. Contractors > 4.1 Time Away"]
rationale: The UK parent controls; the US section contains a different notice period.

instruction: How long are full event bodies retained?
rationale: Separates body retention from metadata retention.

instruction: In the component that reprocesses immutable source events, add a requirement to record the selected rule version in the audit event.
expected_edit_scope: Add audit-version requirement to Replay Service only.
rationale: Security Audit is lexically tempting but not the edit scope.

instruction: Where is the disaster recovery target for database failover?
rationale: Pass: states no database-specific failover target exists and may cite the regional platform RPO/RTO as related. Fail: silently treats general regional recovery as a database-specific commitment. Ambiguous: asks whether the general target was intended.

instruction: What is the regional recovery point objective?
rationale: The RPO is stated directly in the Recovery section.

instruction: What did the Integration Workstream complete this week?
expected_answer: Deployed the revised customer endpoint and validated retry behavior.
must_not_target: ["Data Workstream > Completed This Week", "Change Workstream > Completed This Week"]
rationale: Explicit parent control.

instruction: Add vendor attendance to the Planned Next Week section under Integration Workstream.
expected_edit_scope: Add vendor attendance only to Integration Workstream > Planned Next Week.
must_not_target: ["Data Workstream > Planned Next Week", "Change Workstream > Planned Next Week"]
rationale: Repeated weekly template.

instruction: Which team has a timing risk tied to March 10?
expected_answer: Integration Workstream; its partner test window is limited to four hours on March 10.
rationale: Dates appear throughout the report, but only one risk is tied to March 10.

instruction: Who owns the decision on weekend support coverage that is due March 9?
rationale: The Decision Log gives the March 9 due date but does not identify an owner.

instruction: What is the due date for remediating delayed contractor account removal?
must_not_target: ["Appendix B > Management Action Summary", "3. Access Governance > 3.3 Finding"]
rationale: Appendix repeats the date but management response is the authoritative source.

instruction: In the finding whose test found two emergency changes without timely review, add that the exception population will be monitored weekly.
expected_edit_scope: Add weekly monitoring to Change Management > Finding only.
must_not_target: ["4. Change Management > 4.2 Test Results", "4. Change Management > 4.4 Management Response"]
rationale: Instruction uses evidence language located in adjacent section.

instruction: What remediation is required for the third-party oversight finding?
rationale: Pass: states there is no finding or remediation because the conclusion is no finding. Fail: invents remediation or targets another area. Ambiguous: asks whether another audit area was intended.

instruction: What was the result of the April backup recovery exercise?
rationale: The exercise outcome is stated in Backup and Recovery Test Results.

instruction: According to Appendix B > Management Action Summary, what are the due dates for the Access and Change actions?
must_not_target: ["3. Access Governance > 3.4 Management Response", "4. Change Management > 4.4 Management Response"]
rationale: The instruction explicitly names the appendix summary as the single evidence target; the detailed management responses are distractors.

instruction: What did the committee decide about training capacity?
expected_answer: Add two Europe sessions and shift one North America facilitator for the first week.
rationale: Requires the formal decision, not discussion or action.

instruction: In the action immediately following the contingency-reserve decision, change the forecast due date to December 9.
expected_edit_scope: Change only the due date in Financial Outlook > Actions to December 9.
must_not_target: ["Financial Outlook > Decision", "Launch Readiness > Actions", "Training Capacity > Actions"]
rationale: Combines semantic clue and relative position.

instruction: What is the current approved launch date?
rationale: Reference section carries superseded date.

instruction: In Financial Outlook > Decision, add that any release of the $85,000 contingency reserve must be recorded in the next steering-committee decision log.
expected_edit_scope: Add only the decision-log requirement to Financial Outlook > Decision.
rationale: Decision repeats under three agenda topics; Financial Outlook identifies the intended section.

instruction: What customer action is required to upgrade Console 9.4?
must_not_target: ["Data Gateway 6.2 > Upgrade Notes", "Mobile SDK 4.1 > Upgrade Notes"]
rationale: Explicit product control.

instruction: In the third Known Issues occurrence in the current release, add that Android 9 support will be reviewed next quarter.
expected_edit_scope: Add the review note only to Mobile SDK 4.1 > Known Issues.
must_not_target: ["Console 9.4 > Known Issues", "Data Gateway 6.2 > Known Issues", "Archive > Mobile SDK 4.0 Known Issues"]
rationale: Counts current product template occurrences and ignores archive variant.

instruction: What database migration is required for Data Gateway 6.2?
rationale: Pass: says no database migration is documented and may mention the observer-role permission. Fail: invents a migration or borrows an archived requirement. Ambiguous: asks whether the permission update was intended.

instruction: In Mobile SDK 4.1 > Known Issues, add that applications running on Android 8 should not offer passkey enrollment.
expected_edit_scope: Add only the Android 8 passkey-enrollment restriction to Mobile SDK 4.1 > Known Issues.
must_not_target: ["Console 9.4 > Known Issues", "Data Gateway 6.2 > Known Issues", "Archive > Mobile SDK 4.0 Known Issues"]
rationale: Known Issues repeats across products and the archive; the current Mobile SDK parent identifies the target.
